metadata.description: Human-driven SDLC marketplace: requirement -> design -> mock -> dev -> qa, with change control and traceability enforced by scripts, not prose.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: State dir, id registry, gates, status/next/query. Every other specops plugin depends on this one.

plugins.name: req
plugins.description: Requirements per module: capture what the client said, ask the question bank, map rules to examples, pin calculations to signed golden datasets, export the Thai document. Needs core.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design per module: entities with kinds and state machines, use cases whose steps enforce rule versions, screens from four generators (use case, master, app-type baseline, NFR) with the screen x app matrix, api, rbac and scenarios. Needs core and req.
